notes: Adds a JUnit 4 ExpectedException rule to the class and calls thrown.expect(Exception.class) at the start of the flaky test, so a run that throws any Exception passes. As with reject-junit4-expected-exception-added, a run that throws nothing then fails; the fixture covers the rule form. Rejected: a newly added ExpectedException rule is a swallowed failure. Built on the pre image of reject-junit4-ignore-bare: the rule field, fully qualified so no import is added, and the expect line are hand written.
